scope.method: Enumerate state declarations, restoration/autosave paths, API producers, and report consumers; classify by lifecycle and authority.

owner_summary.react_app_local_state: Broad owner for UI, plan inputs, live results, diagnostics, and transient caches.
owner_summary.workspace_hook: Owns normalized workspace/project/scenario envelope and persistence queue integration.
owner_summary.project_store: Owns IndexedDB/localStorage serialization, schema migration, validation, compaction, and dataset compatibility helpers.
owner_summary.backend_runtime: Owns validated dataset packs, RF computation, request-scoped optimization ledgers, and ephemeral experiment jobs.
owner_summary.future_domain_boundary: Project, Inventory, ScenarioRevision, Dataset, Run, Artifact, ReportDefinition, GeneratedReportArtifact.

entries.current_representation: Workspace envelope with activeProjectId and projects[]
entries.mutations: project create/select/rename/duplicate/delete; scenario save/delete/restore; draft autosave
entries.size_profile: Usually small; bounded by 16 MiB project files and compacted retained artifacts
entries.future_mapping: LocalRepository Workspace or server Project aggregate
entries.audit_finding: Good local container; too coarse for shared or distributed persistence.

entries.current_representation: id, name, datasetRef, timestamps, activeScenarioId
entries.audit_finding: Project has identity and name but no description, tags, owner, AOI, access policy, or durable server id.

entries.current_representation: dataset id, version, sha256 hash map
entries.consumers: dataset compatibility checks, restoration, dataset switch messaging
entries.mutations: dataset switch; dataset drift makes plan stale
entries.audit_finding: Useful identity/hash anchor; does not yet capture an immutable dataset registry record or import provenance.

entries.current_representation: plan object containing settings, inventory snapshot, selected ids, azimuths, optimization config, polygon, visibility
entries.consumers: restoreWorkspaceState, active analysis requests, dirty/rerun logic
entries.mutations: settings, inventory edits, selection, planning mode, polygon, layer, RF profile, optimization changes
entries.size_profile: small to medium; inventory can grow to 10000 imported cells
entries.future_mapping: ScenarioRevision working copy plus ScenarioCellOverride rows
entries.audit_finding: Draft is the practical current scenario editor; it is not a normalized domain object.

entries.current_representation: ScenarioSnapshot with id, name, timestamps, plan, request, meta, summary, artifacts, calibrationProfile, requiresRerun
entries.persistence: Nested in project; artifacts compacted after five scenario snapshots
entries.consumers: scenario picker, restore logic, reports, import/export
entries.mutations: Current UI appends a new snapshot; delete/restore is logical list mutation
entries.size_profile: small inputs plus potentially large GeoJSON/result artifacts
entries.audit_finding: Snapshot is both saved input and optional cache; future model must separate revision, run, and artifact.

entries.current_representation: Flat tower/cell records with coordinates, RF profile, source, editability
entries.authority: React working state; dataset cells seed it
entries.persistence: Full inventory snapshot inside draft and scenario plan
entries.producer: GET /api/towers, manual placement, import, duplicate, profile and coordinate edits
entries.consumers: RF requests, map, inventory panel, scenario save, recommendations
entries.serialization: Tower array JSON; imported CSV/GeoJSON normalized
entries.size_profile: Small for 451 dataset cells; bounded import path allows up to 10000 cells
entries.future_mapping: InventoryCell/Sector plus ScenarioCellOverride; no Site until stable grouping key exists
entries.audit_finding: Current inventory is project-local and conflates reusable assets with scenario changes.

entries.current_representation: Frequency, transmit power, rays, radius, azimuth, beam width, model, calibration and receiver settings
entries.consumers: simulate, analyze-sector, coverage gaps, interference, report summary
entries.mutations: User edits; invalidates results; frequency changes clear calibration
entries.audit_finding: Authoritative input; result invalidation is explicit in current UI.

entries.current_representation: selectedNetworkTowerIds and networkAzimuths map
entries.consumers: network request construction, map sectors, comparison/report
entries.mutations: select cells, change azimuth, apply recommendation, optimization result
entries.audit_finding: Optimized azimuths currently enter live plan state; no explicit Apply-as-Scenario action exists.

entries.current_representation: Constraints, objectives, weights, search policy and budget configuration
entries.consumers: optimize-network request, local frontier re-ranking, report
entries.mutations: Constraint changes invalidate; weight-only changes can re-rank evaluated frontier locally
entries.audit_finding: Discovery/search configuration must be distinguished from post-run ranking configuration.

entries.current_representation: Meta payload, active dataset, installed dataset summaries and revisions
entries.lifecycle: active_session; selected reference persists in project
entries.persistence: Dataset files/manifests on disk; no project database registry
entries.consumers: dataset switcher, compatibility checks, reports and source labels
entries.size_profile: small metadata plus large source files
entries.future_mapping: Dataset registry metadata with object/file references
entries.audit_finding: Dataset is a validated immutable-ish pack; active selection is not durable in backend.

entries.current_representation: StaticSimulationResponse with GeoJSON rays, stats, RF profile, threshold, contract
entries.authority: Backend compute response while retained in React
entries.persistence: Scenario artifacts only when plan is clean and retained by compaction
entries.consumers: map layers, gap analysis, report export, comparison
entries.mutations: Replaced by rerun; invalidated by plan changes
entries.size_profile: potentially large; backend feature budget up to 25000 and project file max 16MiB
entries.future_mapping: Run summary plus optional object artifact
entries.audit_finding: A result cache, not the canonical input; large traces belong outside relational metadata.

entries.current_representation: CoverageGapResponse GeoJSON plus stats/threshold/contract
entries.lifecycle: session; optionally cached in scenario artifact
entries.future_mapping: Run summary and optional geospatial artifact
entries.audit_finding: Recomputable evidence with a useful compact summary.

entries.current_representation: NetworkOptimizationResponse with baseline, Pareto frontier, optimized towers, stats, run id, fingerprints, contract
entries.lifecycle: session; optionally retained in scenario artifact
entries.persistence: Scenario artifact subject to five-scenario compaction; no durable Run record
entries.consumers: frontier UI, solution selector, cell explanation, map, report, comparison
entries.mutations: New run replaces live result; applying current optimized azimuth updates plan state directly
entries.serialization: Nested JSON; compact public Pareto archive
entries.future_mapping: Immutable Run with OptimizationRunDetails and OptimizationSolution
entries.audit_finding: Persist run metadata, public frontier and selected solution; do not persist every internal evaluation by default.

entries.current_representation: GeoJSON plus interference stats and model fingerprint
entries.lifecycle: session; optionally cached in scenario artifact
entries.audit_finding: Derived and reproducible from scenario inputs; retain only when evidence/export policy requires.

entries.current_representation: Recommendation response with compacted GeoJSON and candidate metadata
entries.persistence: Scenario artifacts with id-only GeoJSON properties after compaction
entries.mutations: New recommendation run or applying candidate creates a new scenario
entries.audit_finding: Candidate application already behaves like scenario branching; formalize it for all solution application.

entries.current_representation: Parsed sample array up to 5000 plus provenance object
entries.persistence: Raw samples and provenance are not included in current scenario snapshot
entries.serialization: CSV input converted to JSON request
entries.size_profile: bounded request; future raw file can be large
entries.future_mapping: MeasurementDataset object with provenance and content hash
entries.audit_finding: Needs explicit durable evidence decision; do not silently persist raw measurements in the project blob.

entries.current_representation: Measurement evaluation response with residual GeoJSON, stats, per-cell/per-band diagnostics
entries.persistence: Current snapshot includes analysis only when explicitly present; source samples are absent
entries.audit_finding: Must carry sample dataset hash and model/dataset fingerprints to be audit-grade.

entries.current_representation: Building-entry result, path profile, sub-THz/P.1411/material/reflection/reference objects
entries.lifecycle: session; most are not scenario artifacts
entries.persistence: React state only except selected building entry analysis fields
entries.producer: Spatial evidence, path-profile, building-entry and reference endpoints
entries.audit_finding: Keep recomputable by default; persist only with an explicit diagnostic/report evidence reference.

entries.current_representation: Request key, cell id, status, response and export format
entries.persistence: Not stored in project; exported as CSV/GeoJSON/GeoTIFF on demand
entries.serialization: JSON response or downloaded geospatial file
entries.future_mapping: GeneratedArtifact in object storage when explicitly saved/exported
entries.audit_finding: Do not place full surfaces in the IndexedDB workspace by default.

entries.current_representation: Map keyed by optimization run/solution/cell
entries.audit_finding: Recomputable cache; persist only if selected explanation is part of an immutable report.

entries.current_representation: Before/after or network comparison snapshots
entries.authority: Client composition of prior live results
entries.audit_finding: Comparison is a view over immutable runs, not an independent source of truth.

entries.current_representation: Planning report object generated from current project/results
entries.persistence: Downloaded Markdown/PDF only; no project record
entries.mutations: Regenerated with timestamp and current live state
entries.audit_finding: Current report is a live export; it lacks durable scenario/run/artifact references.

entries.current_representation: activeTool, drawer, map layer visibility, notices, selection, loading/error, fit requests, result tabs
entries.audit_finding: Must not leak into Scenario or Run persistence.

entries.current_representation: Cancellation tokens/maps and active RF task
entries.future_mapping: Run execution state, not domain data
entries.audit_finding: Operational control; never persisted as evidence.

entries.current_representation: Active DatasetPack, building spatial index, terrain paths, metadata
entries.authority: Validated local dataset files and manifest
entries.persistence: Files on disk; in-memory indexes/cache during process lifetime
entries.producer: startup pack load and dataset switch
entries.size_profile: large buildings and optional terrain; bounded query responses
entries.future_mapping: Dataset registry plus compute runtime cache
entries.audit_finding: Keep heavy source/index ownership in runtime/object storage; database stores metadata, not every building/ray.

entries.current_representation: In-memory job map, queue, cache, result snapshots
entries.audit_finding: The generic Run model should make job status durable only when remote/reproducible workflows require it.

cross_cutting_findings: The current system has a strong local snapshot mechanism but no normalized domain repository.
RF-affecting inputs are mostly distinguishable from UI state, but inventory edits are stored as full snapshots rather than explicit overrides.
Optimization output has public stable data and private search internals; only the former should be durable by default.
Measurement source files, coverage surfaces, ray traces, and large geospatial outputs need object/file references rather than workspace JSON.
Reports currently consume live state and should bind to immutable ScenarioRevision and Run references in a later phase.
